name: tree-view
title: Tree View
description: A hierarchical list of items that can be expanded, collapsed, and selected.

props.name: canRename
props.description: Function to determine if a node can be renamed

props.name: defaultCheckedValue
props.description:
The initial checked node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the checked node value.

props.name: defaultExpandedValue
props.description:
The initial expanded node ids when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the expanded node value.

props.name: defaultFocusedValue
props.description:
The initial focused node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the focused node value.

props.name: defaultSelectedValue
props.description:
The initial selected node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected node value.

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Whether clicking on a branch should open it or not

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: The value of the focused node

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the tree elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: loadChildren
props.description:
Function to load children for a node asynchronously.
When provided, branches will wait for this promise to resolve before expanding.

props.name: onBeforeRename
props.description: Called before a rename is completed. Return false to prevent the rename.

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description:
Function to scroll to a specific index.
Useful for virtualized tree views.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
Whether the tree supports multiple selection
- "single": only one node can be selected
- "multiple": multiple nodes can be selected

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether the tree supports typeahead search

events.name: onCheckedChange
events.description: Called when the checked value changes

events.name: onExpandedChange
events.description: Called when the tree is opened or closed

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Called when the focused node changes

events.name: onLoadChildrenComplete
events.description: Called when a node finishes loading children

events.name: onLoadChildrenError
events.description: Called when loading children fails for one or more nodes

events.name: onRenameComplete
events.description: Called when a node label rename is completed

events.name: onRenameStart
events.description: Called when a node starts being renamed

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A tree of nested items, each expandable and selectable.

examples.title: Default expanded
examples.description: Pass `expandedValue` with the ids of branches that should start open.

examples.title: Multiple selection
examples.description: Set `selectionMode="multiple"` to let users select more than one item at once.

examples.title: Controlled selection
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `selectedValue` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `selectedValueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `selectedValue:=state`.

examples.title: Disabled items
examples.description: Mark any node `disabled` — branches and leaves are both skipped by pointer and keyboard interaction.
